docs.desc: EX-99.2 THIRD QUARTER FINANCIAL RESULTS PRESENTATION

reports.title: Axogen, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Guidance
section: For 2026, we expect full-year revenue of at least $290 million, representing growth of at least 29%, including at least $7 million revenue from the BioCircuit acquisition. Excluding BioCircuit, we expect organic revenue to be at least $283 million, representing growth of at least 26%. We continue to expect gross margin to be at least 73%, and positive free cash flow for the full-year.
